_comment: Fixes tense only. The homepage described Decode in the present tense months after the season closed at Worlds. These edits state the same facts as a finished record and remove the dead season from the hero eyebrow, without claiming anything about the next season. NOT INCLUDED, because it needs facts nobody has yet: branding.season is still 'Decode' and prints in the homepage marquee — re-point it once FIRST announces the 2026-27 game, along with a forward-looking hero line.

about.description: Solar Flare Robotics is a second-year FIRST Tech Challenge team from Edgemont, New York, building competitive robots and widening STEM access across our community.

highlights.description: Our second season, Decode, start to finish — from the first qualifier in Albany to the FIRST World Championship in Houston.
